data.desc: Liquidity Services (NASDAQ:LQDT) is the leading global provider of e-commerce marketplaces and software solutions powering the circular economy with over $15 billion in completed transactions to more than six million qualified buyers and 15,000 corporate and government sellers worldwide. The company supports its clients' sustainability efforts by helping them extend the life of assets, prevent unnecessary waste and carbon emissions, and reduce the number of products headed to landfills.
